title: Expose public inquiry submission HTTP adapter and issue submission tokens
requirements: Implement public token issuance and inquiry HTTP submission with accepted APP-001 transaction behavior.
Inject HMAC material and rate-limit enforcement at runtime; missing dependencies fail closed and no production policy is invented.
Add focused API and PostgreSQL integration tests with only synthetic configuration.
acceptance: Configured runtime issues only HMAC-digested one-time tokens and returns safe receipts.
Replays and documented errors have stable, private responses without duplicate writes.
Focused validation, scope, and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: User-authorized public HTTP vertical slice; rate-limit policy remains external and fail-closed.
